reference_pose: Reference: rest pose, neutral arms down. Use for retargeting and rotation offsets, not as a locomotion transition.
rotation_interpolation: Use shortest-path quaternion slerp for runtime pose blending; convert source Euler keys during import.

transitions.sync: preserve normalized cycle phase; quadruped walk-to-bound requires foot-contact review

transitions.rule: commit extracted root yaw to actor orientation before blending
transition on grounded event; use one source of vertical motion

loop_rule: First and last key are matching endpoints; omit duplicate final sample at runtime.
notes: Blend durations are starting values, not tested gameplay tuning.
No AI, hit detection, movement, collision or game code is included.
